details: Overview: Delivered a real-time market pricing and portfolio valuation platform consolidating multi-source data from Bloomberg and ICE to support
Front Office investment decision-making across Equities, Derivatives, and Fixed Income asset classes benchmarking portfolio performance against market
competitors including JPMC."
Problem Statement: The existing pricing process relied on manual data collection from multiple market data sources (Bloomberg, ICE), causing delays in
portfolio valuation, inefficient Front Office analyst workflows, and limited real-time market visibility across asset classes.
Key Contributions:
• Led end-to-end Business Analyst responsibilities for a real-time pricing dashboard from requirements gathering through UAT enabling portfolio
valuation benchmarking against market peers including JPMC across equity and fixed income instruments.

projects.name: Project: Supply Chain Finance & Trade Digitization Platform Client: Mars Inc. | Yash Technology
details: Overview: Mars Inc.'s global supplier payment lifecycle spanning PO management, shipment tracking, Letter of Credit issuance, and bank settlement was
fragmented across enterprise ERP platforms, third-party logistics systems, and banking portals across 15+ countries, with no unified integration layer
connecting supply chain operations to trade finance workflows.
Problem Statement: No unified integration layer existed between Mars's supply chain and their trade finance workflows. LC issuance required manual
bank communication, supplier KYC onboarding was entirely paper-based, and finance teams maintained parallel Excel trackers with zero real-time
transaction visibility resulting in payment delays of 3-5 business days, high reconciliation error rates, and significant compliance risk. Key Contributions:
• Executed As-Is & To-Be state analysis across the supplier lifecycle from PO creation through LC issuance, KYC validation, and payment settlement
eliminating 14 manual intervention points via API-driven automation
